nodes.name: Strengthening Governance & Investment Readiness
nodes.description: GOP prepares promoter-led manufacturers for investment before an investor arrives, and helps them perform against investor KPIs afterwards. The work covers board and governance structures, financial architecture, management depth, due-diligence readiness and investor connect.
